required_authority_bind: verify frozen formalization commits/blob and mirror identity
verify source-audit v1.1 commits/blob and mirror identity
verify every terminal/composition authority commit/blob listed by the formalization
verify implementation hash and immutable router registry
verify no extension oracle / hidden coloring input
verify fresh-source binding before any fresh-witness router evaluation

implementation_contract.direct_terminal_verification: Every emitted T_i must include its exact predicate certificate, authority ref, solver result, reconstruction receipt and independent verifier result.
implementation_contract.composition_verification: Every emitted C1-C3 must include separator certificate, complete boundary-state accounting, exact boundary list transformations, direct-child terminal certificates, parent reconstruction/UNSAT logic.

complexity_instrumentation.mandatory_formula: T_route + T_transform + T_terminal_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify <= poly(|input|)
hard_abort_conditions: candidate count lacks an explicit polynomial upper bound
complexity_instrumentation.coarse_V1_bound: At most O(n^3) separator candidates, <=64 boundary states per size<=3 separator, <=n child components per state, and polynomial direct-terminal checks/solves; plus optional O(n^7) induced-P7 verification. Exact implementation must report its tighter bound.

historical_regression_phase.firewall: FINITE CORPUS ROUTING PASS != ROUTER COMPLETENESS THEOREM

required_before_evaluation.source_binding: Exact authoritative C11/PI source artifact commit/blob/path-or-json-pointer must be frozen before router output is inspected.
required_before_evaluation.legal_input: Must satisfy the frozen D2 pair-fixed C11/PI input contract and exact provenance checks.
required_before_evaluation.fresh: Canonical graph/list/source-role fingerprint must not equal any of the historical frozen-8 regression rows and must not be an exact object used to define a witness-specific T6/T7 terminal.
required_before_evaluation.outcome_independence: The source/generator grammar and enumeration order must be frozen before observing router failures; no hand construction guided by router output.
required_before_evaluation.no_synthetic_promotion: A synthetic object is not authoritative merely because it satisfies graph-level predicates; it needs an already-authorized source-valid C11/PI construction and frozen provenance.

procedure: bind one or more fresh authoritative C11/PI survivor-pair states
for each pair assignment 33,34,43,44 run exact frozen boundary propagation
factor the undecided graph into connected residual components
run the frozen router deterministically on every component
preserve a rejection certificate for every direct terminal and every admissible one-level composition candidate when a component remains unrouted

falsifier.label: UNROUTED_SOURCE_BOUND_WITNESS
falsifier.condition: At least one legal fresh source-bound residual component is rejected by every frozen direct terminal and every frozen V1 one-level composition route.
falsifier.interpretation: Falsifies C11_TERMINAL_ROUTER_COMPLETENESS_CANDIDATE for the frozen V1 registry only.
forbidden_interpretations: P != NP or P = NP evidence

positive_finite_outcome.label: FRESH_SOURCE_BOUND_ROUTING_PASS_FINITE_ONLY
positive_finite_outcome.meaning: All tested fresh source-bound states routed under V1.
positive_finite_outcome.firewall: Absence of a falsifier in finite source-bound testing is not a proof of the universal completeness candidate.

completeness_promotion_rule.required_for_promotion: Separate analytic proof authority or an exact exhaustive characterization of the entire legal C11/PI input domain with independently verified polynomial construction and reconstruction.

formalization_block_check.label: FORMALIZATION_BLOCKED_MISSING_INVARIANT
formalization_block_check.reason: The completeness candidate is definable from the existing D2 pair-fixed residual semantics and frozen terminal predicates without adding a new invariant. Any future need for a new invariant/descriptor requires a separate SOURCE CHECK and HQ authorization.

independent_replay_requirements_if_later: recompute exact propagation and connected components
recompute all size<=3 separator candidates and boundary states independently
verify every SAT reconstruction on the original exact lists/edges
verify every UNSAT claim by the relevant terminal/composition certificate
verify all routing/rejection accounting and polynomial state-count counters
verify historical/fresh separation and zero discovery weight for frozen-8
